messages:
Aditi Rao: Kicking off this thread to schedule the post-incident review for the API outage earlier today. Need a caretaker (host), a note-taker, and confirmation of attendees. Prefer Wed or Thu next week 09:00 PT slot.
Marco Li: I can host Wed 09:00 PT. I’ll prepare the timeline and impact statement.
Jules Carter: I can join and help run RCA section. I need to drop at 09:30 PT but ok to cover first half.
incident-bot: Incident summary (auto): Sev2 - hosted text generation API - 2024-03-05 16:18 UTC. Peak error rate 12% for 42 minutes. Affected customers: Acme, Brightcart. Paging log: https://rwinf/integrations/paging/INC-20240305-001
Aditi Rao: Thanks bot. Marco, you ok to be caretaker? if yes, who will take notes? Priya?
Priya Nair: I can take notes and own the postmortem doc. Will create the tracker issue and fill initial timeline.
Connor Lee: I’ll create the calendar invite once we lock time. Wed 09:00 PT -> 17:00 UTC works for EU. Confirm timezone, please.
Sophia Chen: I’ll loop in CS and add Acme’s SRE contact. They asked for an SLA impact blurb — can someone draft that?
Marco Li: I’ll draft the SLA impact statement and attach to the pre-read. Also will prepare a short demo of the traffic pattern that triggered the autoscaler.
Jules Carter: Suggested agenda: 1) timeline + impact, 2) root cause hypothesis, 3) mitigation & short-term fixes, 4) long-term remediation & owners, 5) customer comms.
Priya Nair: I created PM-1427 in the postmortem tracker. Link: https://rwinf/pm/PM-1427. Added checklist: pre-read, notes doc, action items template.
Connor Lee: Calendar invite draft (I’ll post here and send):
``` 
When: Wed Mar 06 09:00 PT (17:00 UTC)
Where: Zoom - Redwood Meetings
Invite: Postmortem - Hosted API outage - PM-1427
Dial-in: +1 (650) 555-0100
``` 
Connor Lee: Invite sent to: Aditi, Marco, Jules, Priya, Sophia, Acme Support (acme_support@acme.com), infra-oncall. Let me know if I missed someone.
Aditi Rao: Nice. Action owners we need to pre-assign in meeting: (a) live mitigation follow-up (Marco), (b) regression test plan (Jules), (c) customer comms draft (Sophia), (d) postmortem writeup and action tracking (Priya).
Marco Li: Assigned mitigation follow-up to me. I’ll include timeline and ETA for rolling fix.
Jules Carter: I’ll prepare the regression tests and runbook PR.
Sophia Chen: I’ll draft customer comms and coordinate with Acme rep. Can we get a short one-paragraph impact statement by EOD tomorrow?
Priya Nair: I’ll own the postmortem doc and ensure actions are tracked in PM-1427. Will add owners + due dates after meeting.
Aditi Rao: Caretaker fallback: if Marco can’t make, Jules will step in as host. Marco, please confirm backup is okay.
Marco Li: Confirmed. Jules is backup.
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: 24 hours before meeting and 1 hour before meeting. Pre-read deadline: 12 hours before meeting.
Aditi Rao: Can CS add Acme’s rep as observer in the invite and tag legal if any data access items are discussed? @Sophia Chen
Sophia Chen: Will add Acme rep and cc legal if needed. Also we should include a brief timeline in pre-read for customer-facing statement.
Connor Lee: Quick note: please add any logs or traces to the pre-read doc. Use this link to attach artifacts: https://rwinf/artifacts/INC-20240305-001
Priya Nair: Notes doc link: https://rwinf/docs/pm-1427-notes. I’ll start it with timeline + actions section.
Aditi Rao: Final ask: please RSVP by EOD today so I can confirm with CS and legal. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Jules Carter: RSVP: ✅ I’ll be there and join as backup host.
Sophia Chen: RSVP: ✅ I’ll be there and have already notified Acme rep.
Connor Lee: RSVP: ✅ calendar + zoom confirmed.
Marco Li: RSVP: ✅ will prepare impact statement and pre-read.
Priya Nair: RSVP: ✅ will take notes and publish actions after meeting.
Aditi Rao: Closing: see calendar, pre-read in PM-1427, notes doc link above. I’ll run the meeting brief intro. If anything changes ping here.
incident-bot: Thread archived for scheduling. Automated reminders will fire as scheduled.
